newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Abra extends stock rights offer period.
newsitem.headline: Abra extends stock rights offer period.

text.p: The Philippines' Abra Mining and Industrial Corp said on Monday it was extending the offering period for its two-for-one stock rights to November 15.
Originally, the stock rights was supposed to end at noon today.

"The extension was considered on the numerous requests of stockholders to enable them to avail of their subscription rights ... (It) is prompted by the intervening extended holidays starting October 31 up to ... November 3," the company told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
